The test image shows split soybean stems with massive black sclerotia embedded within bleached/white stem tissue — the hallmark diagnostic feature of White Mold. The stems are split open revealing the hollow interior packed with large, irregular black sclerotia. The reference image confirms white mold with similar bleached stems and small developing sclerotia, though the test image shows a more advanced stage with larger sclerotia masses.
